fix_subject: Fix ALTER TYPE dropping concurrently committed updates
pr_title: The column rewrite resolved values at the altering transaction's

labels.summary: ALTER TYPE's column rewrite read at the altering transaction's old snapshot, did not lock the parent table, and marked it altered only after the scan, so concurrently committed updates were silently dropped; the fix reads at the latest commit, locks the parent's append_lock, marks the parent altered first, and restores the mark if the rewrite throws.
